# Fixed-point formats:
# I/Q samples: Q2.14
# Window coeffs: Q2.14
# Accumulators: Q8.56
#
# Format per test case:
# <test_name>
# <num_bins> <num_samples> <window_size> <delay_cycles> <osc_latency>
# FREQ_STEPS (newline separated hex values)
# WINDOW_COEFFS (space-separated hex values)
# I_SAMPLES (space-separated hex values - includes padding + signal)
# Q_SAMPLES (space-separated hex values - includes padding + signal)
# EXPECTED_A_REAL (newline separated hex values)
# EXPECTED_A_IMAG (newline separated hex values)
#
